photos.name: img-7469
photos.summary: Loaf 1 cooling on wire rack just out of the oven. Heavy AP flour dusting (stark white), visible jalapeño slices poking through crust surface. Caramelized cheese melted around the base onto parchment. Good dome shape.

photos.name: img-7472
photos.summary: Hand-torn piece of loaf 1 showing interior crumb — soft enriched texture with visible jalapeño pieces and a melted cheddar pocket. Deep golden crust with caramelized cheese edge.

photos.name: img-7473
photos.summary: Cross-section of loaf 1 showing large melted cheddar pockets and green jalapeño pieces distributed through soft crumb. Crust is deeply caramelized with cheese browning at edges.

photos.name: img-7474
photos.summary: Wide cross-section of loaf 1 — extensive cheddar melt concentrated in the lower half, jalapeño pieces throughout. Crumb is soft and pillowy with an enriched bread texture.

photos.name: img-7475
photos.summary: Loaf 2 halved on cutting board showing full cross-section of both halves. Well-distributed jalapeño pieces and cheddar pockets throughout. More even crumb structure than loaf 1. Bread knife alongside.

photos.name: img-7476
photos.summary: Loaf 2 whole on cutting board — noticeably smoother skin than loaf 1, less stark flour dusting. Single score line along top opened well. Caramelized cheese at base. Better spring visible.

photos.name: img-7477
photos.summary: Loaf 2 from above on cutting board showing cross score pattern and flour dusting. Smoother, more rounded shape than loaf 1. Cheese visible at edges where it melted through during bake.

photos.name: img-7478
photos.summary: Screenshot of friend's photo — last piece of loaf on cutting board with bread knife. Messages: 'This is how much is left. Until I eat in a few moments.'

photos.name: img-7479
photos.summary: Screenshot of iMessage conversation — friend's review after eating the loaf. 'It's delicious.' / 'Bro. This is the best bread you've ever made.' / 'I'd stake my life on it.'
